subject.name: LLM Gateway client SDK source preview

assertions.description: the gateway tests preserve default denial, key and project scoping, and usable direct-credential snapshots
the Node client tests cover nine JSON and text-SSE dialect paths, cache isolation, fallback, and stream failure boundaries
the Python client tests cover nine JSON and text-SSE dialect paths, cache isolation, fallback, and stream failure boundaries
the Go client tests cover nine JSON and text-SSE dialect paths, cache isolation, fallback, and stream failure boundaries
the actual gateway handler delivers a scoped snapshot and all three clients survive its loss with direct JSON and converted SSE

questions.question: For the source-only preview, should the three SDK clients and the gateway snapshot be one accepted subject, qualified by these fixture assertions without a blanket real-provider certification?
questions.resolution: Yes. This is one source-only preview of the scoped gateway snapshot and all three client SDKs. The fixture-backed assertions qualify the preview's owned behavior, without certifying every live upstream provider.
